Summarise schedule disparity by team and season

Source: R/season_summary.R
calc_schedule_disparity.Rd

Rolls the game-level components from calculate_schedule_advantage() up to one row per team-season. The result is the season-level companion to the per-game composite: it shows how much rest, travel, and body-clock burden a team accumulated, and where it ranked relative to the rest of the league.

Usage

calc_schedule_disparity(
  schedule,
  team_home = nfl_airports,
  venues = nfl_stadiums,
  trip_model = c("itinerary", "round_trip"),
  ...
)

Arguments

schedule

A schedule accepted by calculate_schedule_advantage().

team_home

Team home-base lookup. Defaults to nfl_airports.

venues

Venue lookup. Defaults to nfl_stadiums.

trip_model

Travel model passed to calculate_travel_miles(). Defaults to "itinerary".

...

Additional arguments passed to calculate_schedule_advantage(), such as component weights.

Value

A tibble with one row per team-season: season, team, games, home_games, away_games, travel_games, total_travel_miles, mean_trip_miles, longest_trip_miles, missing_trips, short_weeks, off_byes, mean_rest_days, mean_rest_disparity, eastward_trips, westward_trips, mean_tz_shift, max_eastward_shift, mean_schedule_advantage, total_schedule_advantage, advantage_rank, travel_rank, and rest_rank.

Details

Ranks are within season. advantage_rank = 1 is the most favorable schedule (highest mean schedule_advantage), travel_rank = 1 is the most travel, and rest_rank = 1 is the most rest relative to opponents. mean_schedule_advantage is from the team's perspective: the game-level home-positive composite is negated for road games.

Examples

season <- calc_schedule_disparity(nfl_schedules_sample)
subset(season, season == 2024)[1:5, c(
  "team", "total_travel_miles", "mean_schedule_advantage", "advantage_rank"
)]
#> # A tibble: 5 x 4
#>   team  total_travel_miles mean_schedule_advantage advantage_rank
#>   <chr>              <dbl>                   <dbl>          <dbl>
#> 1 ARI               19721.                  0.0310             14
#> 2 ATL               10400.                  0.272               3
#> 3 BAL               15337.                  0.132               9
#> 4 BUF               17620.                  0.0951             11
#> 5 CAR               20653.                  0.122              10
